title: Learning Continuous Neural Representation of Stochastic Hybrid Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.38893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A stochastic hybrid system (SHS) is governed by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) describing the continuous dynamics and a Markov reset kernel triggered on the guard surface. Its probability evolution can be described by a hybrid Fokker-Planck (HFP) equation with a partial differential term corresponding to the SDE and an integral term arising from the reset kernel. This work shows that such an SHS can be approximated by an SDE in a higher-dimensional latent space where the sample paths are continuous. The key to this result is to encode different branches of the reset kernel using auxiliary variables, transforming the resets into deterministic ones that enable topological gluing. By the embedding theorem, the glued manifold can then be embedded into a higher-dimensional Euclidean space. translated_title: 随机混合系统的连续神经表示学习
translated_abstract: 随机混合系统（SHS）由描述连续动力学的随机微分方程（SDE）以及在守卫面上触发的马尔可夫重置核所支配。其概率演化可由混合Fokker-Planck（HFP）方程描述，该方程包含对应于SDE的偏微分项和由重置核产生的积分项。本工作表明，这样的SHS可以在更高维的潜空间中被一个SDE所近似，其样本路径是连续的。这一结果的关键在于利用辅助变量对重置核的不同分支进行编码，将重置转化为确定性的重置，从而实现拓扑粘合。根据嵌入定理，粘合后的流形可进一步嵌入到更高维的欧几里得空间中。我们证明，在嵌入的像上，概率演化不再需要HFP方程中的显式重置项。基于这一理论（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本论文证明，通过用辅助变量编码重置核的各分支并进行拓扑粘合与高维空间嵌入，随机混合系统可以近似为高维潜空间中样本路径连续的随机微分方程，从而消除混合Fokker-Planck方程中的显式重置项。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a stochastic hybrid system can be approximated by a continuous-path SDE in a higher-dimensional latent space—by encoding reset kernel branches with auxiliary variables, topologically gluing them, and embedding the manifold—thereby eliminating explicit reset terms from the hybrid Fokker-Planck equation.
